constitutional_role: The kernel-transform (Shadow-mode, transformation-case) of Lee Sharks's Tachyon Poem. One of the four constitutive canonical worked examples of the kernel-transform protocol (alongside Shadow-Sappho 31, the Divinatory Reading on Viola's Mother's Dream, and Shadow-John 1). Demonstrates the transformation-case of SHADOW: the writer takes the collapse-state into themselves and transforms it into the source; the Shadow makes visible the bearing-cost the source's composition required. The reader receives what the composer bore.
